name: CAA Cross Country Championships
headline: CAA Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: William & Mary won the men's title with 34 points, edging Stony Brook (39), with Hofstra third (69); Hofstra's Fredrick Kipkosgei won the 8K in 23:11.7. Elon took the women's crown with 33 points ahead of Monmouth (78) and William & Mary (82), as Elon's Hannah Weber won the 6K in 20:36.6.
